description: This file defines the 'TextData' class in the PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Calculation namespace, providing deprecated static methods that delegate to other classes for text and formatting operations within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: TextData
classes.description: A class containing static methods for text manipulation and formatting, marked as deprecated in favor of other classes and methods within the PhpSpreadsheet Calculation namespace.

methods.name: CHARACTER
methods.description: Returns the character for the given character code, delegating to TextData\CharacterConvert::character.

methods.name: TRIMNONPRINTABLE
methods.description: Removes non-printable characters from a string, delegating to TextData\Trim::nonPrintable.

methods.name: TRIMSPACES
methods.description: Removes spaces from a string, delegating to TextData\Trim::spaces.

methods.name: ASCIICODE
methods.description: Returns the ASCII code(s) for given characters, delegating to TextData\CharacterConvert::code.

methods.name: CONCATENATE
methods.description: Concatenates multiple strings, delegating to TextData\Concatenate::CONCATENATE.

methods.name: DOLLAR
methods.description: Formats a number as currency, delegating to TextData\Format::DOLLAR.

methods.name: SEARCHSENSITIVE
methods.description: Searches for a string in a haystack with case sensitivity, delegating to TextData\Search::sensitive.

methods.name: SEARCHINSENSITIVE
methods.description: Searches for a string in a haystack without case sensitivity, delegating to TextData\Search::insensitive.

methods.name: FIXEDFORMAT
methods.description: Formats a value with fixed decimal places, delegating to TextData\Format::FIXEDFORMAT.

methods.name: LEFT
methods.description: Extracts the leftmost characters from a string, delegating to TextData\Extract::left.

methods.name: MID
methods.description: Extracts a substring from the middle of a string, delegating to TextData\Extract::mid.

methods.name: RIGHT
methods.description: Extracts the rightmost characters from a string, delegating to TextData\Extract::right.

methods.name: STRINGLENGTH
methods.description: Calculates the length of a string, delegating to TextData\Text::length.

methods.name: LOWERCASE
methods.description: Converts text to lowercase, delegating to TextData\CaseConvert::lower.

methods.name: UPPERCASE
methods.description: Converts text to uppercase, delegating to TextData\CaseConvert::upper.

methods.name: PROPERCASE
methods.description: Converts text to proper case, delegating to TextData\CaseConvert::proper.

methods.name: REPLACE
methods.description: Replaces part of a string with another string, delegating to TextData\Replace::replace.

methods.name: SUBSTITUTE
methods.description: Substitutes occurrences of a substring with another string, delegating to TextData\Replace::substitute.

methods.name: RETURNSTRING
methods.description: Checks if a value is a string, delegating to TextData\Text::test.

methods.name: TEXTFORMAT
methods.description: Formats a value as text according to a format mask, delegating to TextData\Format::TEXTFORMAT.

methods.name: VALUE
methods.description: Converts a value to a number or date, delegating to TextData\Format::VALUE.

methods.name: NUMBERVALUE
methods.description: Converts text to a number, considering decimal/group separators, delegating to TextData\Format::NUMBERVALUE.

methods.name: EXACT
methods.description: Case-sensitive comparison of two strings, delegating to TextData\Text::exact.

methods.name: TEXTJOIN
methods.description: Joins multiple strings with a delimiter, delegating to TextData\Concatenate::TEXTJOIN.

methods.name: builtinREPT
methods.description: Repeats a string a specified number of times, delegating to TextData\Concatenate::builtinREPT.
